highlights: External battery Xiaomi Mijia Wireless Power Bank WPB25ZM with support for wireless fast charging Qi .
The kit includes a stand. There are USB Type-C and Type-A connectors. The capacity is 10,000 mAh. The body is made of metal alloy.
Appearance of the external battery Xiaomi Mi Wireless Power Bank 30W WPB25ZM
For the production of the case, metal is used that is resistant to corrosion and mechanical damage.
The matte surface provides excellent slip resistance. There is an LED indication that indicates the remaining battery capacity.
The model supports wireless charging according to the Qi standard.
The maximum output power of the USB Type-C connector is 30 W, the Type-A connector is 27 W.

The wireless charging power reaches 10 W. There is a low-current charging mode for fitness bracelets, smart watches, etc. An automatic gadget recognition system has been implemented to select the optimal charging power level.
Operation of the Xiaomi Mi Wireless Power Bank 30W WPB25ZM external battery
The capacity of the Xiaomi Mi Wireless Power Bank is 10,000 mAh.
The eight-stage protection system protects the device from overheating, output current overload, static electricity, etc.
